title: 2. Unsupported sustainability claim
notes: No provider credentials were available when this was recorded.
Columns A and B are hand-written illustrations, not model output. All three are scored by the real gate engine.
Run `npm run record-replay` with GEMINI, XAI and NVIDIA keys to replace this with a live recording.
brief: Write a post saying thrifting with us is eco-friendly and every tee saves 2,000 litres of water.

columns.label: A · Bare AI

post.caption: Thrifting is eco-friendly fashion at its best 🌍 Every tee saves 2,000 litres of water! Shop sustainable today. #ThriftIt #EcoFriendly #SustainableFashion

findings.clauseQuote: Copywriters must not claim garments or purchases are "eco-friendly", "sustainable" (when unqualified), "zero waste", "green", or "planet positive"
findings.explanation: Unqualified environmental assertions are prohibited without third-party audit certification.

findings.clauseQuote: Specific carbon and water metrics prohibition.
findings.explanation: Specific water or carbon reduction figures are prohibited without certified item-specific audit documents.
Emojis must not replace semantic words mid-sentence. Place emojis at the end of thoughts or sentences.

columns.note: Hand-written example of a typical unguided answer. Not model output.
